title: US racing to occupy Earth-Moon Lagrangian point

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. No, we are I know this. We are racing um as the United States government to occupy that space and orbit.

plain: The United States government is racing to occupy a Lagrangian point between Earth and the Moon, a spot in space where the two bodies' gravity balances so that something can hold its position there. That is what Eric Burlison, a US congressman, tells Jesse Michels, saying he knows this firsthand. If true, it would mean a quiet contest is under way this decade to claim strategic positions in space.
